title: Turkey: Right -wing nationalist Devlet Bachseli is being hospitalized after serious heart surgery -
text:
Heart surgery underwent Turkish President’s government partner and leader of the Supernatural Nationalist Party (Mir), Devlet Bachseli.
The T24 Information Website, which is affiliated with the Opposition Officer’s CHP, initially reported that doctors replaced a heart valve, information which was subsequently confirmed and officially confirmed.
In a statement by the Nationalist Party, MHP President Devlet Bachseli was admitted to Anadolu Medical Center on February 4, 2025 for scheduled exams and treatments. As a result of exams and medical estimates, after finding degeneration on the heart valve replaced 10 years ago, the existing valve was interventionally replaced on 6 February 2025 and the process was successfully completed without complications. His state of health is extremely good and stable and he rests in his room. In a short period of time, hospitalization will be completed and return to his daily life. “
Bachseli’s rumor rumors began to spread yesterday, Wednesday, with information saying he was hospitalized due to a cardiac problem. Opposition Halk TV television had reported that 77 -year -old Devlet Bachseli was taken to a hospital on the Asian side of Constantinople, following an indulgence from his heart. One day earlier, on Tuesday, the regular meeting of the Mir Parliamentary Group was not held, in which Bachseli is always the only speaker.
The Mir announced on the other hand that the postponement of the meeting of the parliamentary group was due to the cough that was plagued by Bachseli. Pro -government circles even argued that the leader of the MP is not facing any health problems and went to the hospital for regular health tests.
On October 22, last year, the president of the Nationalist Party of Nationalist Action, a key political body of the far -right gray wolves, to the surprise of all, had submitted a proposal to release the leader of the Kurdish Armed Forces PKK, Abdullah, Abdullah, armed action and invite the members of the PKK to dismantle the organization he himself established. Ocalan has been held imprisoned since 1999, in the island of Imrali in Poropodida, resolving a life sentence. The proposal was supported by President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and information wants Ocalan to prepare to make a statement on the resolution of the Kurdish, probably on February 15, responding to the Bachseli initiative.
